description: Regular waves (2nd-order Stokes, H = 0.07 m, T = 1.22 s, d = 0.505 m) on a vertical cylinder D = 0.25 m (Chen et al. 2014), two-phase CFD with k-omega, tutorial 11_14 on the half domain y = 1.5..3 m (symmetry plane through the cylinder axis, force x 2). Surface elevation at x = 5 m and inline force against the measurements; the time lag is fitted on the gauge.

reference.citation: Chen, L.F., Zang, J., Hillis, A.J., Morgan, G.C.J. & Plummer, A.R. (2014) Numerical investigation of wave-structure interaction using OpenFOAM. Ocean Engineering 88, 91-109; measured data from the REEF3D tutorial 11_14 (Bihs et al. 2016, Computers & Fluids 140)
